claim: Visitors see days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking below the written date
Each countdown has a title, target time, end message and optional button with link
At zero the digits stay and the message appears beneath
The widget needs Layout Builder to be placed on a page
Live ticking and the end message need JavaScript; without it visitors see the written date and the time left when the page was built
The editor types the local start time in the chosen time zone, summer time is applied, and the time zone starts as UTC
18:00 typed for Europe/London in July is stored as 17:00 UTC and reads 6:00 PM BST
Its colours follow the rest of your site
Screen readers hear the time left once when the page loads and again when it ends
The same works for an open day, a launch or an entry deadline
